form.label: MITRE ATT&CK Coverage
form.description: What this deployment detects, what it does not, and which rules have actually proven themselves against real activity. Built from this app's own mapping lookup rather than a premium add-on, so it works on a stock Splunk Enterprise install.

search.query: | inputlookup mitre_attack_lookup | where mitre_tactic_id != "NA" | stats dc(mitre_tactic_id) AS tactics
| inputlookup mitre_attack_lookup | where mitre_technique_id != "NA" | stats dc(mitre_technique_id) AS techniques
| rest /servicesNS/-/siem_core/saved/searches | search eai:acl.app=siem_core title!="default" | stats count AS rules

html.p: Each row is a technique this deployment detects. Rows marked active have fired in the selected window and are therefore validated end to end; rows marked deployed, no activity are enabled but unproven - they may be correct and simply idle, or they may be silently broken. That distinction is the difference between claimed coverage and demonstrated coverage.

search.query: | inputlookup mitre_attack_lookup | where mitre_tactic_id != "NA" | join type=left rule_id [ search index=siem_summary $scope_tok$ | stats count AS alerts, latest(_time) AS last_fired BY rule_id ] | eval alerts = coalesce(alerts, 0), last_fired = if(isnull(last_fired), "never", strftime(last_fired, "%F %T")), status = if(alerts > 0, "ACTIVE - validated", "deployed, no activity"), technique = mitre_technique_id . " " . mitre_technique | sort mitre_tactic_id, - alerts | table mitre_tactic_id, mitre_tactic, technique, rule_id, rule_name, severity, alerts, last_fired, status, data_source | rename mitre_tactic_id AS "Tactic ID", mitre_tactic AS "Tactic", technique AS "Technique", rule_id AS "Rule", rule_name AS "Detection", severity AS "Severity", alerts AS "Alerts", last_fired AS "Last fired", status AS "Status", data_source AS "Data source"
| inputlookup mitre_attack_lookup | where mitre_tactic_id != "NA" | stats dc(mitre_technique_id) AS techniques, count AS rules BY mitre_tactic | sort - rules
index=siem_summary $scope_tok$ | lookup mitre_attack_lookup rule_id OUTPUT mitre_tactic | where isnotnull(mitre_tactic) AND mitre_tactic != "Operational" | timechart span=1d count BY mitre_tactic

panel.title: Coverage gaps - ATT&CK Enterprise tactics with no detection deployed

html.p: Computed live from the mapping lookup rather than maintained by hand, so it stays accurate as rules are added. Each gap is a telemetry problem before it is a detection problem - closing one means onboarding a data source, not writing a smarter search.

search.query: | makeresults | eval tactic_id = split("TA0043,TA0042,TA0001,TA0002,TA0003,TA0004,TA0005,TA0006,TA0007,TA0008,TA0009,TA0011,TA0010,TA0040", ",") | mvexpand tactic_id | eval tactic = case( tactic_id="TA0043","Reconnaissance", tactic_id="TA0042","Resource Development", tactic_id="TA0001","Initial Access", tactic_id="TA0002","Execution", tactic_id="TA0003","Persistence", tactic_id="TA0004","Privilege Escalation", tactic_id="TA0005","Defense Evasion", tactic_id="TA0006","Credential Access", tactic_id="TA0007","Discovery", tactic_id="TA0008","Lateral Movement", tactic_id="TA0009","Collection", tactic_id="TA0011","Command and Control", tactic_id="TA0010","Exfiltration", tactic_id="TA0040","Impact") | join type=left tactic_id [ | inputlookup mitre_attack_lookup | where mitre_tactic_id != "NA" | stats count AS rules, values(rule_id) AS rule_ids BY mitre_tactic_id | rename mitre_tactic_id AS tactic_id ] | eval rules = coalesce(rules, 0), coverage = if(rules > 0, "covered", "GAP"), rule_ids = if(isnull(rule_ids), "-", mvjoin(rule_ids, ", ")) | table tactic_id, tactic, rules, rule_ids, coverage | rename tactic_id AS "Tactic ID", tactic AS "Tactic", rules AS "Rules", rule_ids AS "Detections", coverage AS "Coverage"
